disorder-name.detail: Major depressive disorder clinical cohort; normative modeling applied to patients.
disorder-name.supporting_text: This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium.

dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium.

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD across DIDA-MDD (n=1148; 33.83 ± 22.17) and REST-meta-MDD (n=1276; 36.23 ± 21.378).
age.supporting_text: The final sample included 1148 patients with MDD (age: 33.83 ± 22.17 years, females: 58.62%) and 1079 HCs (age: 33.96 ± 19.25 years, females: 56.81%). The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD (age: 36.23 ± 21.378 years, females: 63.71%) and 1104 HCs (age: 36.15 ± 24.552 years, females: 58.06%).

sex.detail: Counts estimated from reported female percentages per dataset (DIDA-MDD: 58.62%; REST-meta-MDD: 63.71%) and rounded to whole numbers.
